title: Outstandingly Tangy Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: A traditional Algerian dish with a tangy twist, featuring lamb, red wine, and kombu cold extract, perfect for a midnight craving. This recipe is low in glycemic index, making it friendly for those with dietary restrictions.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the lamb pieces with salt, black pepper, cumin, and paprika.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the lamb pieces on all sides, then remove them from the pot.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is softened.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the red wine, kombu cold extract, and browned lamb pieces to the pot.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Cook the tagine for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
